verdict.rationale: incident.io documents public and private Status Pages and Workflows that automatically publish to the status page when an incident is updated, so a public page driven from incident state is supported. Neither of the story's two named features, custom domains and subscriber notifications, appears anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notification capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.
With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
